description: Parse an M3U or CSV document (the inverse of export_playlist) and append its Spotify URIs to a target playlist. Pass the document inline via content, or read it from input_path (a regular file inside the configured read roots). URIs already in the playlist are skipped, so a re-run adds nothing. Adds in batches of 100. Use dry_run=true to preview without writing. Result records the document source and the use made of it (consent_note); under 100 new URIs nothing is gated.

content.description: The M3U or CSV document body, passed inline

dry_run.description: Parse and report what would be added without touching the playlist

input_path.description: Read the document from this local file instead of content

playlist_id.description: Target playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or share URL

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: import_playlist
